title.zh: AI趋势 | 传Moonshot估值达500亿美元后拟于2027年初IPO
title.en: AI TRENDS | Moonshot Said to Eye Early 2027 IPO After Valuation Hits $50 Billion

current_state.zh: Moonshot AI已完成最后一轮私募融资，估值达500亿美元，并计划于2027年第一季度在香港IPO，可能募资高达50亿美元；预计到12月年度经常性收入将达20亿美元。
current_state.en: Moonshot AI has completed its final private funding round at a $50 billion valuation and is targeting a Hong Kong IPO in Q1 2027 that could raise up to $5 billion; annual recurring revenue is expected to reach $2 billion by December.
